text:
maya: FYI — PR #4123 landed but I spotted a couple broken links in the pricing -> tiers section and the metering SDK header example still uses the old header style. can someone triage?
jonathan: can you paste the exact broken url(s)?
maya: sure — main one: https://docs.redwood.com/pricing#usage-tiers (returns 404). also the snippet in /docs/metering/headers.md shows Authorization: Bearer <KEY> instead of the x-api-key header we now prefer in our SDK examples.
sasha: I can take this. plan: fix the links, add a small migration note, and add python + ts SDK snippets using the current header recommendation. will keep the legacy example behind a brief note for backcompat.
liam: heads-up — dashboard panels were renamed last week (metering -> consumption). that explains a couple of the 404s. either add redirects or update the text to the new panel names. @sasha please pick one approach and call it out in the PR.
emily: also the burst credits section is still vague — customers reported confusion. suggest adding a concrete example like: 100k tokens/day -> X burst credits consumed. maybe a tiny formula.
sasha: ack. I'll add a mini worked example and a compact code snippet for computing estimated burst usage. will preview in staging.
docs-bot: PR #4210 opened by sasha — "docs: pricing/tiers link fixes + metering header SDK snippets". Reviewers requested: @jonathan, @emily. CI: pending.
jonathan: tiny nit for the TS snippet — use client.generate({ model: 'rwd/light-2', input: '...' }) instead of the legacy generateText call. also prefer named param for headers: { headers: { 'x-api-key': RW_KEY } } shown explicitly.
sasha: good catch, updating. current draft python snippet (will include in PR):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('RW_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model='rwd/light-2', input='hello world', headers={'x-api-key': os.environ['RW_KEY']})
print(resp.output)
```
and TS snippet: 
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd/light-2', input: 'hello' }, { headers: { 'x-api-key': process.env.RW_KEY } })
console.log(resp.output)
```
liam: for redirects, we prefer adding entries to redirects.yml so old links keep working. please add one for /pricing#usage-tiers -> /pricing#usage-consumption (or whatever final anchor is). also add a quick unit test for redirects if possible.
sasha: will add redirect entry + test. also adding a changelog note under /docs/CHANGELOG.md and a short migration blurb in the API migration guide.
maya: thanks — can you backport the link fix to the 1.2 docs branch? a couple of enterprise customers are still on that branch.
liam: +1 for backporting, but ensure the redirects test runs in the 1.2 pipeline (it was flaky last week).
sasha: will queue backport PR after main branch merge, and I'll re-run the redirect test locally first.
emily: I made a quick checklist comment in the PR to keep reviewers focused: 1) fix links, 2) update dashboard names + redirects, 3) add py/ts SDK snippets with x-api-key, 4) add burst credits example, 5) add redirects.yml entry, 6) add changelog & migration note, 7) backport to 1.2.
maya: perfect. ping me when CI is green and I'll do a quick QA pass in staging. :thumbsup:
jonathan: will review later today. thanks for grabbing this, sasha.
sasha: thanks — aiming to have PR green by EOD. will post updates here.
